method: Independent same-team read-only manual source review; no code or tests executed; source may still change before freeze.
scope: Finite set-valued adaptive policy constructor, feasibility verifier, continuation, add-on CLI and draft native bridge.

findings.subject: Cached search-state cap does not bound expanded certificate size or serialization work
findings.evidence: instrument.solve caches child trees by state, inserts shared child trees per symbol and recursively serializes candidate trees for tie comparison; repeated synonymous symbols can expand many copies despite bounded cached state count. CLI serializes full result.
findings.impact: Declared finite input/state limits do not establish20CPU-second or70MiB campaign bounds; runner hard limit and honest bounded materialization needed.
findings.suggestion: Enforce output/policy-node and computation limits with incomplete status, avoid repeated full canonical expansion or use compact DAG tie key, and run in externally bounded subprocess.

findings.subject: Native bridge is unsubmitted schema/helper compatibility smoke, not full operating invocation
findings.evidence: native_bridge.native_receipt creates ExplorationBundle draft, explicitly native_bundle_submitted=False, and executes fixed two-hypothesis predecessor example independent from supplied adaptive problem.
findings.impact: Cannot qualify native operating integration or matched predecessor improvement from this receipt.
findings.suggestion: Keep full native qualification BLOCKED and smoke scope explicit. Do not bypass owner/permit/runtime boundaries.

findings.subject: Verifier establishes policy feasibility, not optimizer optimality or model adequacy
findings.evidence: verify docstring and optimality_checked=False explicitly separate claims; authority_granted=False and coverage_qualified=False required.
findings.impact: Independent exhaustive oracle still necessary for optimality; finite authored observations do not establish real-world adequacy or beneficiary value.

positive_inspection_observations: Exact integer checks reject bool costs and negative/out-of-range values.
Closed input fields and bounded inert identifiers avoid executable experiment definitions.
All hypotheses require nonempty bounded prediction sets; IDs unique.
Solver returns incomplete on exhausted state budget rather than false infeasible.
Verifier traverses every possible branch and rejects repeats/disallowed probes/budget or leaf inconsistency/tampered problem.
Continuation rejects out-of-model and out-of-order observations, and never grants real execution authority.
supplemental_tests_recommended: Worst-case policy/canonical expansion with synonymous outcomes; ensure bounded honest incomplete result and timeout receipt.
Duplicate IDs, empty outcomes, unknown/missing hypothesis predictions, overlong names/input and bool/noninteger cost validation.
Tampered branch missing/extra, repeated probe, disallowed probe, false leaf, budget/depth and report totals.
Changed problem commitment and out-of-model transcript refusal.
Independent oracle feasibility/minimax-cost comparison on frozen fresh cases; full denominator and incomplete cases retained.
Document schema/helper compatibility smoke separately from actual native runtime qualification.
